Class TaskTideManagerUtility

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.core.manager.TaskTideManagerUtility
public class TaskTideManagerUtility extends Object
Collection of static methods to support ManagerTask to TaskTideModel.

1). Handling Step for WorkItem

2). Handling Workflow for Step. Where workflow name defaults to the same as that for the step. Meaning, random "Arbitrary" tasks can still be viewed as they are, and workflows developed as individual steps, without interfering with defined workflows (StepA, StepB, StepC) Maybe some methods for ManagerCommand instead?
